name: How does AKN Design Group's design-build process approach paver installation?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group's design-build process approach paver installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our integrated design-build process for paver installation means we manage the project from initial concept and CAD-supported layouts through construction, installation, and final walkthrough. This approach ensures that your paver design seamlessly integrates with other elements of your outdoor living space, such as outdoor kitchens, lighting, or covered structures. By coordinating all aspects under one team, we eliminate the complexities of working with multiple contractors and ensure the final result aligns precisely with your vision and our high standards of craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our design-build process integrates paver installation from concept to completion, ensuring seamless integration with other outdoor elements and a single point of coordination.
